**Status:** Proposed | Accepted | Deprecated | Superseded by ADR-XXX

**Date:** YYYY-MM-DD

## Context

What is the problem or force at play? What constraints, requirements, or prior
decisions are relevant? Keep this factual and neutral.

## Decision

that a reader can tell whether a future change conflicts with it.

## Consequences
